title: Reliable Evaluation Protocol for Low-Precision Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the systematic deviation or 'score bias' in retrieval systems by calculating the difference between conventional tie-oblivious retrieval metrics (e.g., nDCG, MRR) and the mathematical expectation of those metrics across all permutations of tied candidates (Tie-aware Retrieval Metrics) caused by low-precision scoring.
